_comment: Output budget guard: recall output for a topic with many verbose matches must stay within the fixture token budget. Green at baseline (single-line recall); must STAY green once recall becomes multi-evidence (Phase 1.5).

items.subject: store migration plan
items.text: Decision: migrate store persistence in three passes — schema first behind a version gate, then dual-write memory items and notes for one release, then cut reads over and drop the legacy tables. Alternatives: single big-bang migration rejected because rollback would lose captured episodes.

items.subject: migration blocker
items.text: Blocker: the store migration dual-write pass cannot start until the schema version gate lands, because better-sqlite3 prepares statements eagerly and the new columns do not exist on older databases in the wild.

items.subject: migration fts rebuild
items.text: Insight: the migration must rebuild the fts index after backfill — triggers only cover incremental writes, so a bulk backfill leaves the fts table empty and recall silently returns nothing for migrated rows.

items.subject: migration wal checkpoint
items.text: Insight: long migration transactions hold the wal file open and inflate it past 100mb; checkpoint between passes keeps the database file size stable on developer machines.

items.subject: migration test cycle
items.text: Test cycle: migration suite failed twice on foreign key cascade order, passed after moving the memory_references backfill behind the memory_items insert.
Command (build): npm run build && node scripts/migrate.js --dry-run (exit 0)
